# API

Base path `/api/v1`. Reads are open; POST, PUT and DELETE need `Authorization: Bearer $MURMUR_API_TOKEN`. Errors are `{"detail": ...}`; lists take `limit`/`offset` and return `total`. The interactive version is `/docs` on a running instance; published files are under `/data` (see the data dictionary).

## charts

### `GET /api/v1/charts/leadlag.png`

The lead/lag chart rendered on demand (the one PNG the API draws; the UI draws everything else from JSON).

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `as_of` | query | string or null |  |
| `months` | query | integer or null |  |
| `source` | query | string | "all" |
| `method` | query | string | "pearson" |

## index

### `GET /api/v1/index/{name}`

The constituents in force for a month (or on a date), with rank and weight.

Companies added to and removed from the index in a month (default: the latest).

### `GET /api/v1/index/{name}/level`

The daily level between ``from`` and ``to`` (default: the whole history).

| `name` | path | string |  |

One session: the level and every member's start-of-day weight, daily return and contribution (return units and index points), largest contribution first. ``latest`` for the most recent session.

|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string |  |
| `day` | path | string |  |

## leadlag

### `GET /api/v1/leadlag`

The rolling lead/lag table as of a day. Pass ``months=0`` / ``source=`` / ``method=`` empty to get every horizon, source or method.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `as_of` | query | string or null |  |
| `months` | query | integer or null | 3 |
| `source` | query | string or null | "all" |
| `scope` | query | string or null | "pooled" |
| `ticker` | query | string or null |  |
| `method` | query | string or null | "pearson" |

### `GET /api/v1/leadlag/history`

How one rolling number moved day by day.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `months` | query | integer | 3 |
| `window` | query | string | "day" |
| `return_type` | query | string | "daily" |
| `lag` | query | integer | 1 |
| `source` | query | string | "all" |
| `method` | query | string | "pearson" |
| `scope` | query | string | "pooled" |
| `ticker` | query | string | "" |

### `GET /api/v1/placebo`

The shuffle test as of a day (default: the latest): for each horizon and lag of day sentiment vs the daily return, the real pooled r and the distribution of r when each session's sentiment is shuffled across companies (``null_*``), with ``z`` and the permutation p-value.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `as_of` | query | string or null |  |

## status

### `GET /api/v1/health`

503 when the store is unreachable or an in-process worker thread died. In the split deployment the scheduler and worker containers have their own health checks; their heartbeat ages are reported here but do not fail the API's own check.

### `GET /api/v1/health/report`

One JSON document for a watcher (the host's murmur-check timer). Always 200 unless ``strict=true``, which answers 503 when there are problems.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `strict` | query | boolean | false |

### `GET /api/v1/latest`

The overview page in one call.

### `GET /api/v1/logs`

Logs

|---|---|---|---|
| `lines` | query | integer | 200 |
